headline: Sensex snaps 2-day fall to gain over 300 points as oil cools
why: Cooling crude oil prices provided significant relief to domestic equity markets.
Positive global market cues, including Nikkei's 1% gain following AI stock rallies.
Strengthening Indian Rupee, which rose 16 paise against the US dollar in early trade.
whatHappening: Sensex recovered over 300 points while Nifty comfortably crossed the 23,200 mark.
Metals and FMCG sectors outperformed during the day, compensating for weakness in IT stocks.
Tata Group stocks faced selling pressure after the Shapoorji Pallonji Group backed a Tata Sons listing.
Gold prices surged to Rs 1.52 lakh/10 gram while silver gained Rs 1,000/kg as oil prices dropped.

stocksInNews.sources: Tata Group stocks fall as Shapoorji Pallonji Group backs Tata Sons listing
IT sector drags market performance ahead of the US Fed interest rate decision
Metals shine and lead market gains alongside FMCG stocks
FMCG sector gains momentum as benchmark indices snap a two-day losing streak

summary: Indian benchmark indices rebounded as cooling crude oil prices and strong global market cues lifted investor sentiment. While metals and FMCG sectors drove the market recovery, IT stocks and Tata Group equities faced downward pressure.
